rubric_provenance.method: Manual single-pass authoring while implementing this benchmark layer; provisional until independently re-reviewed.

required_facts.description: A ValueError from parsing the config file's JSON now propagates to the caller instead of being caught and replaced with an empty dict.

Whether any caller of load_config currently depends on receiving {} for malformed config, and how such a caller would behave if a ValueError now propagates instead, is not shown anywhere in this diff.
When the file's contents parse successfully as JSON, load_config still returns the parsed value directly, exactly as before; only the exception-handling path changed.
